en.s: The siege of Pirisabora took place when the Roman Emperor Julian besieged the fortified city of Pirisabora under Mamersides in April 363. After two days of fierce fighting, the Sasanians and the citizens abandoned the circuit walls and took up a defensive position in the acropolis. After some failed attempts, the Romans began to construct a siege tower, after which Mamersides reached a compromise with Julian to hand over the fort in exchange for a safe withdrawal.

zh.s: 363年4月，罗马皇帝尤利安围攻由马默西德斯驻守的皮里萨博拉坚固城池。经过两天激战，萨珊军队和当地居民放弃环城城墙，退守卫城。罗马军几次进攻未果后开始建造攻城塔，马默西德斯随后与尤利安达成协议，交出堡垒以换取安全撤离。

en.s: An earthquake originating in the Central Apennines was felt in Rome and Spoleto on 29 April 801. It is reported in two independent contemporary sources, Einhard's Royal Frankish Annals and the Liber Pontificalis. The information provided by the written sources has been augmented by archaeology. Both the Annals and the Liber date the event to 30 April according to contemporary Roman practice, whereby the day began at sundown.

zh.s: 801年4月29日，亚平宁山脉中部发生的地震在罗马和斯波莱托均有震感。两份独立的同时代资料都记载了这场地震：《艾因哈德皇家法兰克年代记》和《教宗名录》。考古发现也补充了文献中的信息。根据当时罗马人的记日方式，一天从日落开始，两份文献将地震日期记为4月30日。

en.s: The Battle of Levounion was the first decisive Byzantine victory of the Komnenian restoration. On 29 April 1091, an invading force of Pechenegs was crushed by the combined forces of the Byzantine Empire under Alexios I Komnenos and his Cuman allies.

en.s: The Battle of the Vikhra River took place on 29 April 1386 on the Vikhra River, a tributary of the Sozh, near Mstislavl, between the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and the Principality of Smolensk. The Lithuanians achieved a decisive victory and Smolensk was forced to accept being a vassal of Lithuania.

zh.s: 维赫拉河战役于1386年4月29日在姆斯季斯拉夫尔附近的维赫拉河畔爆发。维赫拉河是索日河的支流。交战双方是立陶宛大公国和斯摩棱斯克公国。立陶宛军大获全胜，斯摩棱斯克被迫接受成为立陶宛的附庸。

en.t: The Crown's decision to expel the Jews is announced in Zaragoza, Aragon, to the kingdom's procurators
en.s: On 31 March 1492, the Catholic Monarchs of Spain, King Ferdinand II of Aragon and Queen Isabella I of Castile, issued the Alhambra Decree, ordering all unconverted Jews to leave their kingdoms and territories by the end of July that year, unless they converted to Christianity.

zh.t: 阿拉贡王国萨拉戈萨向王国代理人宣布驱逐犹太人的决定
zh.s: 1492年3月31日，西班牙天主教君主——阿拉贡国王费尔南多二世和卡斯蒂利亚女王伊莎贝拉一世——颁布《阿尔罕布拉法令》，要求所有未改信基督教的犹太人在当年7月底前离开其王国和领地，除非他们改信基督教。

en.s: The Battle of Västerås (Swedish: Slaget om Västerås) was a battle in the Swedish War of Liberation that took place on Badelundaåsen, north of Västerås, Sweden on April 29, 1521. The Swedish troops, led by Gustav Vasa, defeated the Danish force, led by Didrik Slagheck, and conquered Västerås. Gustav Vasa, who after going to Gästrikland and attempting to rally support for his rebellion, returned to Dalarna in early April and was informed of the victory in the Battle of Brunnbäck Ferry. He decided to continue onwards to Västerås. His troops had on April 23 made camp by Romfartuna Church, where the army was mustered.

zh.s: 韦斯特罗斯战役是瑞典解放战争期间的一场战斗，于1521年4月29日在瑞典韦斯特罗斯以北的巴德伦达岭发生。古斯塔夫·瓦萨率领的瑞典军队击败迪德里克·斯拉格赫克率领的丹麦军队，并攻占韦斯特罗斯。古斯塔夫·瓦萨此前前往耶斯特里克兰，试图为起义争取支持；4月初返回达拉纳后，他听说瑞典军队在布伦贝克渡口战役中获胜，于是决定继续前往韦斯特罗斯。4月23日，他的部队已在罗姆法图纳教堂附近扎营集结。

en.s: The Battle of Barbados also known as the Action of Carlisle Bay was a military action that took place off the Caribbean island of Barbados on 29 April 1665 just before the outbreak of the Second Anglo-Dutch War. It was fought between an English force defending against an attacking Dutch force led by Michiel de Ruyter.

zh.s: 巴巴多斯海战又称卡莱尔湾海战，于1665年4月29日、第二次英荷战争爆发前不久，在加勒比海岛国巴巴多斯附近发生。英国军队在此抵御米希尔·德·鲁伊特率领的荷兰军队进攻。

en.t: Emilio Altieri is elected pope after a four-month conclave and takes the name Clement X
en.s: The 1669–70 papal conclave (21 December – 29 April) was convened on the death of Pope Clement IX and ended with the election of Cardinal Emilio Altieri as Pope Clement X. The election saw deference within the College of Cardinals to Louis XIV of France, and a freeing of the cardinals loyal to Spain to vote according to their conscience.

zh.s: 1669至1670年教宗选举秘密会议于1669年12月21日至1670年4月29日举行，选举是在教宗克勉九世去世后召开的，最终枢机主教埃米利奥·阿尔蒂耶里当选教宗，取名克勉十世。选举期间，枢机团对法国国王路易十四表示尊重，并允许忠于西班牙的枢机主教按自己的意愿投票。

en.s: For other battles with this name, see Battle of Cuddalore (disambiguation) The naval Battle of Cuddalore took place on 29 April 1758 during the Seven Years' War near Cuddalore off the Carnatic coast of India and was an indecisive battle between a British squadron under Vice-Admiral George Pocock and French squadron under Comte d'Aché. British casualties were 29 killed and 89 wounded, while France lost 99 killed and 321 wounded. Although the battle itself was indecisive, the French fleet was able to achieve its primary objective of delivering the reinforcements that the defenders of Pondicherry were awaiting.

zh.s: 1758年4月29日，七年战争期间，卡达洛尔附近、印度卡纳提克海岸外海发生卡达洛尔海战。乔治·波考克海军中将率领的英国分舰队与阿谢伯爵率领的法国分舰队交战，战斗没有分出胜负。英国伤亡为29人死亡、89人受伤；法国伤亡为99人死亡、321人受伤。尽管战果未定，法国舰队仍完成了主要任务，将援军送到正在等待援军的本地治里守军手中。

en.s: The action of 29 April 1758 was a naval engagement fought in the Bay of Biscay near Brest between a British Royal Navy squadron and a single French Navy ship of the line during the Seven Years' War. In an attempt to support the garrison of Louisbourg, who were facing an impending siege, the French Atlantic Fleet sent a number of squadrons and ships to sea during the spring of 1758.

zh.s: 1758年4月29日，七年战争期间，英国皇家海军一支分舰队与法国海军一艘战列舰在布雷斯特附近的比斯开湾交战。为支援即将面临围城的路易斯堡守军，法国大西洋舰队于1758年春派出多支分舰队和舰船出海。

en.s: The siege of Quebec, also known as the second siege of Quebec, was a 1760 French attempt to retake Quebec City, in New France, which had been captured by Britain the previous year. The siege lasted from 29 April to 15 May, when British ships arrived to relieve the city and compelled the French commander, François Gaston de Lévis, to break off the siege and to retreat.

zh.s: 魁北克围城战又称第二次魁北克围城战，是法国于1760年试图夺回新法兰西魁北克市的一次行动；该城前一年被英国占领。围城于1760年4月29日至5月15日持续进行。英国舰船抵达增援后，迫使法国指挥官弗朗索瓦·加斯东·德·莱维解除围城并撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Royal was a naval battle fought off Fort Royal, Martinique in the West Indies during the Anglo-French War on 29 April 1781, between fleets of the British Royal Navy and the French Navy. After an engagement lasting four hours, the British squadron under Admiral Samuel Hood broke off and retreated. Admiral de Grasse offered a desultory chase before seeing the French convoys safe to port.

zh.s: 皇家堡海战于1781年4月29日在西印度群岛马提尼克岛皇家堡附近海域爆发，是英法战争的一场海战。英国皇家海军和法国海军舰队交战。经过四小时交战，塞缪尔·胡德海军上将率领的英国分舰队脱离战斗并撤退。德·格拉斯海军上将随后短暂追击，确认法国船队安全驶入港口后便停止追击。

en.s: The Battle of Marquain was a conflict between Austria and the Kingdom of France during the War of the First Coalition. It took place on 29 April 1792 and ended in a French defeat.

en.s: The Battle of Mouscron (28–29 April 1794) was a series of clashes that occurred when the Republican French Army of the North under Jean-Charles Pichegru moved northeast to attack Menin (now Menen) and was opposed by Coalition forces under the overall leadership of François Sébastien Charles Joseph de Croix, Count of Clerfayt. In their initial advance, the French began the siege of Menin and captured Courtrai (now Kortrijk).

zh.s: 穆斯克龙战役（1794年4月28日至29日）是一系列交战。让-夏尔·皮舍格吕率领的法兰西共和国北方军向东北移动，准备进攻梅宁（今梅嫩），途中遭到由弗朗索瓦·塞巴斯蒂安·夏尔·约瑟夫·德·克鲁瓦、克莱尔费伯爵统领的反法同盟军阻击。法军推进初期开始围攻梅宁，并攻占科特赖克（今科特赖克）。

en.t: 1800–01 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1800–01 United States House of Representatives elections were held on various dates in various states between April 29, 1800, and August 1, 1801. Each state set its own date for its elections to the House of Representatives before the first session of the 7th United States Congress convened on December 7, 1801.

en.t: 1806–07 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1806–07 United States House of Representatives elections were held on various dates in various states between April 29, 1806 (in New York) and August 4, 1807 (in Tennessee). Each state set its own date for its elections to the House of Representatives before the first session of the 10th United States Congress convened on October 26, 1807. They occurred during Thomas Jefferson's second term.

en.s: The capture of HMS Epervier was a naval action fought off the coast of Florida near Cape Canaveral on 29 April 1814, between the United States ship-rigged sloop-of-war USS Peacock, commanded by Master Commandant Lewis Warrington, and the British Cruizer-class brig-sloop Epervier under Commander Richard Wales. Peacock captured Epervier after a one-sided cannonade, but the British merchant convoy escaped.

zh.s: 俘获英国皇家海军“鹞鹰”号是一场海战，于1814年4月29日在佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角附近海域发生。交战双方是刘易斯·沃灵顿海军少校指挥的美国海军双桅战船“孔雀”号，以及理查德·威尔士海军上校指挥的英国“巡洋舰”级双桅舰“鹞鹰”号。经过一场一边倒的炮战，“孔雀”号俘获了“鹞鹰”号，但英国商船队成功逃脱。

en.t: The galaxy Centaurus A or NGC 5128 is discovered by James Dunlop
en.s: Centaurus A (also known as NGC 5128 or Caldwell 77) is a galaxy in the constellation of Centaurus. It was discovered in 1826 by Scottish astronomer James Dunlop from his home in Parramatta, in New South Wales, Australia. There is considerable debate in the literature regarding the galaxy's fundamental properties such as its Hubble type (lenticular galaxy or a giant elliptical galaxy) and distance (11–13 million light-years).

zh.t: 半人马座A星系由詹姆斯·邓洛普发现
zh.s: 半人马座A星系又称NGC 5128或科德韦尔77，位于半人马座。苏格兰天文学家詹姆斯·邓洛普于1826年在澳大利亚新南威尔士州帕拉马塔的家中发现了它。学界对该星系的一些基本性质仍有争议，例如它属于透镜状星系还是巨型椭圆星系，以及它距离地球是1100万还是1300万光年。

The Navajo achieved a surprise attack but was ultimately repulsed by 150 American defenders of the 3rd Infantry under Captain Oliver L.

zh.s: 迪法恩斯堡战役是美国纳瓦霍战争时期发生的一场军事交战。1860年4月29日，约1,000名纳瓦霍战士袭击了新墨西哥领地迪法恩斯堡的美国陆军驻军，该地如今位于亚利桑那州境内。纳瓦霍人发动了突然袭击，但最终被150名美国守军击退；守军隶属第3步兵团，由奥利弗·L·……上尉指挥。

en.t: Maryland in the American Civil War: Maryland's House of Delegates votes not to secede from the Union
en.s: During the American Civil War (1861–1865), Maryland, a slave state, was one of the southern border states, meaning that it shared a border with a non slave-holding state of the North. Despite some popular support for the cause of the Confederate States of America, Maryland did not secede during the Civil War. Governor Thomas H. Hicks, despite his early sympathies for the South, helped prevent the state from seceding.

zh.t: 美国内战期间的马里兰州：马里兰州众议院投票决定不脱离联邦
zh.s: 美国内战（1861—1865年）期间，蓄奴州马里兰是南方边境州之一，也就是说，它与北方一个不实行奴隶制的州接壤。尽管当地有一部分民众支持美利坚联盟国，马里兰在内战期间并未脱离联邦。州长托马斯·H·希克斯早年同情南方，但他帮助阻止了该州脱离联邦。

en.t: Engagements at Pineberry, Willtown, and White Point
en.s: The Battle of The Pineberry Battery (or Engagements at Pineberry, Willtown, and White Point) was a series of minor engagements, fought April 29, 1862, in Charleston County, South Carolina, during the American Civil War. The engagements proceeded from an attack by the Union Navy on a battery on John Berkeley Grimball's plantation on Edisto Island. After successfully destroying the battery, the ship was attacked twice by Confederate artillery forces before returning to its station.

zh.t: 派恩贝里、威尔敦和怀特角交战
zh.s: 派恩贝里炮台战役又称派恩贝里、威尔敦和怀特角交战，是一系列小规模战斗，于1862年4月29日在美国内战期间发生于南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿县。交战始于联邦海军袭击埃迪斯托岛约翰·伯克利·格里姆巴尔种植园内的一座炮台。联邦军成功摧毁炮台后，军舰两次遭邦联炮兵攻击，随后返回驻地。

en.s: The Battle of Grand Gulf was fought on April 29, 1863, during the American Civil War. In the Vicksburg Campaign of Maj. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant, Union naval forces under Rear Adm. David D. Porter led seven ironclads in an attack on the Confederate fortifications and batteries at Grand Gulf, downriver from Vicksburg, Mississippi. Although the Confederates withstood the Union bombardment and prevented infantry from landing against their fortification, the defeat was only a minor setback to Grant's plan to cross the Mississippi River and advance against Vicksburg.

zh.s: 格兰德湾战役于1863年4月29日、美国内战期间爆发。作为尤利西斯·格兰特少将维克斯堡战役计划的一部分，大卫·波特海军少将率领联邦海军的七艘铁甲舰，攻击密西西比州维克斯堡下游格兰德湾的邦联防御工事和炮台。邦联军顶住了联邦军的炮击，并阻止步兵登陆攻打防御工事。虽然联邦军受挫，但这只是格兰特渡过密西西比河、进军维克斯堡计划中的小挫折。

en.s: The Battle of Pyzdry, one of many skirmishes of the January Uprising, took place on April 29, 1863, near the town of Pyzdry, which at that time belonged to Russian-controlled Congress Poland. 1200 Polish insurgents under Edmund Taczanowski and Alojzy Oranowski clashed here with 1500 soldiers of the Imperial Russian Army. The battle ended in Polish victory. Pyzdry, a town in historic Greater Poland, was at that time located in western part of Congress Poland, near the border with Kingdom of Prussia’s Province of Posen. The uprising did not reach this part of Prussia, but Poznan, where Poles were in the majority, supported the uprising with volunteers, weapons, money, uniforms and equipment.

zh.s: 皮兹德雷战役是波兰一月起义期间的多场小规模战斗之一，于1863年4月29日在皮兹德雷镇附近发生。当时该地属于俄国控制的波兰会议王国。埃德蒙·塔昌诺夫斯基和阿洛伊齐·奥拉诺夫斯基率领1200名波兰起义军，与1500名俄罗斯帝国士兵交战，最终波兰军获胜。皮兹德雷位于历史上的大波兰地区，当时属于波兰会议王国西部，靠近普鲁士王国波森省边境。起义没有蔓延到普鲁士这一地区，但波兰人占多数的波兹南为起义提供志愿者、武器、资金、制服和装备。

en.t: Theta Xi fraternity is founded at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, the only fraternity to be founded during the American Civil War
en.s: Theta Xi (ΘΞ) is a North American Greek-letter social college fraternity. It was founded at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute in 1864. Of all the social fraternities today, Theta Xi was the only one founded during the Civil War. Its Grand Lodge is headquartered in downtown Atlanta. Since its inception, Theta Xi has grown to include more than 60,000 initiated members. Currently, there are approximately 45 active chapters and one colony.

zh.s: Theta Xi（ΘΞ）是北美一所大学兄弟会，名称采用希腊字母。该组织于1864年在伦斯勒理工学院成立。在现今所有社交型兄弟会中，Theta Xi是唯一一个在美国内战期间成立的。其总会位于亚特兰大市中心。成立以来，Theta Xi已发展到拥有6万多名正式成员，目前约有45个活跃分会和一个预备分会。

en.s: The Parliament of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland is the supreme legislative body of the United Kingdom. It meets at the Palace of Westminster in London. It is bicameral, consisting of the House of Commons and the House of Lords, with the sovereign forming a third constitutional element. Acting together to legislate, these constitute the King-in-Parliament.
en.n: The Parliament of the United Kingdom passes the People's Budget, the first budget in British history with the expressed intent of redistributing wealth among the British public.

zh.n: 英国议会通过《人民预算案》。这是英国历史上首个明确以重新分配民众财富为目的的预算案。

en.s: The Easter Rising (Irish: Éirí Amach na Cásca), also known as the Easter Rebellion, was an armed insurrection in Ireland during Easter Week in April 1916. The Rising was launched by Irish republicans against British rule in Ireland with the aim of establishing an independent Irish Republic while the United Kingdom was fighting the First World War.

zh.s: 复活节起义（爱尔兰语：Éirí Amach na Cásca）又称复活节叛乱，是爱尔兰人在1916年4月复活节周发动的武装起义。爱尔兰共和派反抗英国在爱尔兰的统治，目标是建立独立的爱尔兰共和国；当时英国正参与第一次世界大战。

en.s: Battle of Syrjäntaka was a 1918 Finnish Civil War battle fought on 28–29 April in Syrjäntaka, Tuulos, between the German Baltic Sea Division and the Finnish Red Guards. Thousands of Red refugees were fleeing east, while they were blocked by a small unit of Germans at a highway crossing in the small village of Syrjäntaka. After hours of desperate fighting, the Reds managed to break through and continue their journey.

en.s: The Battle of Viipuri was a 1918 Finnish Civil War battle, fought 24–29 April between the Finnish Whites and the Finnish Reds in Viipuri. Together with the Battle of Tampere and Battle of Helsinki, it was one of the three major urban battles of the Finnish Civil War. The battle is also remembered because of its bloody aftermath, as the Whites executed up to 400 non-aligned military personnel and civilians of Russian and associated ethnicities.

zh.s: 维堡战役是芬兰内战期间的一场战斗，于1918年4月24日至29日在维堡发生，交战双方是芬兰白卫队和芬兰红卫队。它与坦佩雷战役和赫尔辛基战役并称芬兰内战三大城市战役。战役结束后发生的血腥事件也让它被人记住：白卫队处决了多达400名未参战的军人，以及俄罗斯族和相关族裔平民。

en.s: General elections to the Cortes Generales were held in Spain on 29 April 1923. At stake were all 409 seats in the Congress of Deputies. The 1923 general election would be the final election governed by the customary turno system. As expected, it legitimated a prearranged shift of power from the Conservatives to the Liberals. The system ended with the September 1923 coup of Miguel Primo de Rivera, and the next elections - held after eight years of dictatorship and the removal of the monarchy - would be competitive.

zh.s: 1923年4月29日，西班牙举行大选，选出西班牙议会成员，共改选众议院409个席位。这是按传统轮流执政制度举行的最后一次选举。正如外界所料，选举只是为预先安排的政权从保守派转向自由派提供合法性。1923年9月米格尔·普里莫·德·里维拉发动政变后，这套制度结束。下一次选举是在八年独裁统治结束、君主制被废除后举行的，届时才出现真正竞争。

en.s: The Hongkou Park Incident was a bombing attack on military and colonial personnel of the Empire of Japan at 11:40 am on April 29, 1932. It occurred at Hongkou Park (now "Lu Xun Park"), Shanghai, Republic of China, during a ceremony that honored the birthday of the Emperor of Japan, Hirohito. The attack was planned and conducted by the Korean Patriotic Organization, a militant arm of the Korean Provisional Government (KPG).

zh.s: 虹口公园事件是一次针对日本帝国军方及殖民官员的爆炸袭击，于1932年4月29日上午11时40分发生在中华民国上海虹口公园（今鲁迅公园）。当时公园内正在举行庆祝日本天皇裕仁生日的仪式。袭击由韩国爱国团策划并实施；该组织是韩国临时政府的武装组织。

en.s: The 1933 FA Cup final was a football match between Everton and Manchester City on 29 April 1933 at Wembley Stadium in London. The deciding match of English football's primary cup competition, the Football Association Challenge Cup (better known as the FA Cup), it was the 62nd final, and the 11th at Wembley. The 1933 final was the first where the players, including goalkeepers, were issued numbers for identification.

zh.s: 1933年英格兰足总杯决赛于1933年4月29日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由埃弗顿对阵曼彻斯特城。这场比赛决出了英格兰主要足球杯赛足总挑战杯（通常称为足总杯）的冠军，是第62届决赛，也是温布利球场举办的第11场决赛。决赛首次为球员配发号码，包括守门员，以便辨认。

en.s: The 1939 FA Cup final was contested by Portsmouth and Wolverhampton Wanderers at Wembley. Portsmouth won 4–1, with goals from Bert Barlow, John Anderson and two by Cliff Parker. Dicky Dorsett scored Wolves' effort. As a result of the suspension of the FA Cup for the duration of the Second World War, the next FA Cup final was not until seven years later in 1946, thereby enabling Portsmouth fans to claim that their team has held the Cup for the longest time.

zh.s: 1939年英格兰足总杯决赛由朴茨茅斯对阵狼队，在温布利举行。朴茨茅斯以4比1获胜，伯特·巴洛、约翰·安德森和克利夫·帕克进球，其中帕克打入两球；狼队由迪基·多塞特打入一球。由于第二次世界大战期间足总杯停办，下一场决赛直到七年后的1946年才举行，因此朴茨茅斯球迷可以说他们的球队捧杯时间最长。

en.s: The Battle of Parang, Cotabato in 1942 saw the Japanese Kawaguchi Detachment land on the shores of Parang town in Cotabato province, Philippines, on April 29, 1942, as part of their invasion of Mindanao, facing resistance from the Philippine Army's 2nd Regular Regiment under Lieutenant Colonel Calixto Duque, who managed to delay the Japanese advance for several hours despite eventually being forced to withdraw due to the overwhelming Japanese forces and the fall of nearby Cotabato City; this battle marked a key point in the Japanese occupation of southern Mindanao.

zh.s: 1942年4月29日，日军川口支队在菲律宾哥打巴托省的巴朗镇海岸登陆，入侵棉兰老岛。菲律宾陆军第2常规团在卡利克斯托·杜克中校率领下抵抗，虽最终因日军兵力压倒性占优以及附近哥打巴托市陷落而被迫撤退，但仍拖慢了日军数小时。这场战斗是日军占领棉兰老岛南部的重要节点。

en.s: Japanese Invasion of Malabang (Filipino: Paglusob ng mga Hapones sa Malabang) was part of the Japanese landings on the western coast of Mindanao that began on April 29, 1942. Kawaguchi Detachment landed in three important points in west coast of Mindanao including Malabang in then undivided Lanao Province. Defending forces of Filipino and American troops resisted but lacked artillery, and due to Japanese naval and air support were overwhelmed and forced to retreat.

zh.s: 日军入侵马拉邦是日本于1942年4月29日起在棉兰老岛西海岸登陆行动的一部分。川口支队在棉兰老岛西海岸的三个要地登陆，其中包括当时位于未分治的拉瑙省内的马拉邦。菲律宾和美国守军进行了抵抗，但因缺乏火炮，加上日军得到海空军支援，最终被击败并被迫撤退。

en.t: Dachau concentration camp is liberated by United States troops
en.s: Dachau (UK: , ; US: , ; German: [ˈdaxaʊ] ) was one of the first concentration camps built by Nazi Germany and the longest-running one, opening on 22 March 1933. The camp was initially intended to intern the Nazi Party's political opponents, which consisted of communists, social democrats, and other dissidents.

zh.t: 美国军队解放达豪集中营
zh.s: 达豪是纳粹德国最早建造的集中营之一，也是运行时间最长的集中营，于1933年3月22日开放。该营最初用于关押纳粹党的政治对手，包括共产主义者、社会民主主义者和其他异见人士。

en.s: The Surrender at Caserta (Italian: Resa di Caserta, pronounced [ˈreːza di kaˈzɛrta, ˈreːsa -, - kaˈsɛrta]) of 29 April 1945 was the written agreement that formalized the surrender of German and Italian Fascist forces in Italy, ending the Italian Campaign of World War II.

zh.s: 卡塞塔投降书（意大利语：Resa di Caserta）于1945年4月29日签署，是一份书面协议，正式确认德国军队和意大利法西斯军队在意大利投降，结束了第二次世界大战的意大利战役。

en.s: Operation Howard was a British special forces operation by B and C Squadrons, 1st Special Air Service led by Paddy Mayne that took place from 6 to 29 April 1945. It was to provide reconnaissance for the Canadian 4th Armoured Division in its advance towards Oldenburg in north-western Germany. The operation was hampered by German ambushes and boggy ground in which the Jeeps found hard going.

zh.s: 霍华德行动是英国特种部队的一次行动，由帕迪·梅恩率领的第一特别空勤团B、C中队于1945年4月6日至29日执行，为加拿大第四装甲师向德国西北部奥尔登堡推进提供侦察。行动受到德军伏击和泥泞地面的阻碍，吉普车在泥地上难以行驶。

en.t: World War II: Allied airdrops of food begin over German-occupied regions of the Netherlands
en.s: Operations Manna, Chowhound and Faust provided food to relieve a famine in the 1944–1945 German-occupied Netherlands. By May 1945, about 20,000 people in the Netherlands had died of starvation and three million were surviving on an ever-diminishing supply of food. The main area impacted by the famine encompassed the large cities in the west. The operations were undertaken by Allied air and ground forces in the last ten days of World War II.

zh.t: 盟军开始向德国占领下的荷兰空投粮食
zh.s: “马纳行动”“猎犬行动”和“浮士德行动”旨在为1944至1945年德国占领下的荷兰缓解饥荒。到1945年5月，荷兰约有2万人死于饥饿，另有300万人靠日渐减少的食物维持生活。受灾最严重的地区包括西部的大城市。这些行动由盟军空军和地面部队执行，发生在第二次世界大战结束前的最后十天。

en.s: The Battle of Collecchio-Fornovo (26–29 April 1945) was a battle of the Second World War fought between the Brazilian Expeditionary Force (Força Expedicionária Brasileira – FEB) and Italian partisans, with supporting armor attachments from the American 1st Armored and 92nd Infantry Divisions, against the retreating Axis forces of the Wehrmacht's 148th Infantry Division, 90th Panzergrenadier Division, and the fascist National Republican Army's 1st Bersaglieri "Italia" and 4th Alpini "Monte Rosa" Divisions.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 科莱基奥-福尔诺沃战役（1945年4月26日至29日）是第二次世界大战期间的一场战斗。交战双方包括巴西远征军和意大利游击队，以及支援他们的美国第一装甲师和第92步兵师装甲部队；对手是正在撤退的轴心国部队，包括德国国防军第148步兵师、第90装甲掷弹兵师，以及法西斯国家共和军第一“意大利”燧发枪兵师和第四“蒙特罗萨”阿尔卑斯师。

en.s: The defense of the Redoute Ruinée in 1945 was an episode of the Second Battle of the Alps. The Fort de la Redoute Ruinée (Ruined Redoubt) was an old Piedmontese fort on the Col de la Traversette that had been re-built in the 19th century by France as a part of the Ligne Alpine. It defended the Little Saint Bernard Pass.

en.t: The International Military Tribunal for the Far East convenes and indicts former Prime Minister of Japan Hideki Tojo and 28 former Japanese leaders for war crimes
en.s: The International Military Tribunal for the Far East (IMTFE), also known as the Tokyo Trial and the Tokyo War Crimes Tribunal, was a military trial convened on April 29, 1946, to try leaders of the Empire of Japan for their crimes against peace, conventional war crimes, and crimes against humanity, leading up to and during World War II.

zh.t: 远东国际军事法庭开庭
zh.s: 远东国际军事法庭又称东京审判或东京战争罪审判，于1946年4月29日开庭，审判日本帝国的领导人，追究他们在第二次世界大战前及战争期间犯下的破坏和平罪、传统战争罪和反人类罪。

en.s: The 1950 FA Cup final was the 69th final of the FA Cup. It took place on 29 April 1950 at Wembley Stadium and was contested between Arsenal and Liverpool. Arsenal won the match 2–0 to win the FA Cup for the third time, with both goals scored by Reg Lewis. The Arsenal team also featured cricketer Denis Compton, who played alongside his brother Leslie.

zh.s: 1950年英格兰足总杯决赛是该项赛事的第69场决赛，于1950年4月29日在温布利球场举行，由阿森纳对阵利物浦。阿森纳以2比0获胜，第三次夺得足总杯冠军；雷格·刘易斯打入两球。阿森纳队中还有板球运动员丹尼斯·康普顿，他与弟弟莱斯利并肩参赛。

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 29 April 1950 to elect the 75 members of the state's Legislative Assembly. The Labor government was seeking its seventh continuous term in office since the 1932 election; it would be Premier Ned Hanlon's second election. The Assembly had been increased in size prior to the election by the Electoral Districts Act 1949 from 62 to 75 seats.

zh.s: 1950年4月29日，澳大利亚昆士兰州举行选举，选出州立法议会75名议员。工党政府自1932年选举以来连续执政，此次力争第七个任期；这也是州长内德·汉隆第二次参加选举。此前，1949年选区法案将议会席位从62席增加到75席。

en.s: Pan American World Airways Flight 202 was a Boeing 377 Stratocruiser aircraft that crashed in the Amazon Basin about 281 nautical miles (320 mi; 520 km) southwest of Carolina, Brazil, on April 29, 1952. The accident happened en route from Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, to Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago, during the third leg of a four-leg journey.

zh.s: 泛美航空202号班机是一架波音377“同温层巡航者”客机。1952年4月29日，飞机在巴西卡罗利纳西南约281海里（320英里或520公里）的亚马逊盆地坠毁。事故发生时，飞机正从里约热内卢飞往特立尼达和多巴哥的西班牙港，处于全程四段航程中的第三段。

en.t: The first U.S. experimental 3D television broadcast shows an episode of Space Patrol on Los Angeles ABC affiliate KECA-TV
en.s: 3D television (3DTV) is a type of television that conveys depth perception to the viewer by employing techniques such as stereoscopic display, multi-view display, or any other form of 3D display. Most modern 3D television sets use an active shutter 3D system or a polarized 3D system, and some are autostereoscopic without the need of glasses. As of 2017, most 3D TV sets and services are no longer available from manufacturers.

zh.t: 美国首次进行实验性3D电视转播，内容为洛杉矶ABC附属电视台KECA-TV播出的《太空巡逻队》一集
zh.s: 3D电视（3DTV）通过立体显示、多视角显示或其他3D显示方式，让观众感受到深度。大多数现代3D电视机采用主动快门或偏振式3D系统；有些则无需眼镜，能够自动呈现立体影像。截至2017年，多数制造商已不再提供3D电视机和相关服务。

en.s: The 17th Cannes Film Festival took place from 29 April to 14 May 1964. Austrian filmmaker Fritz Lang served as jury president for the main competition. On this edition, the Palme d’Or was renamed "Grand Prix du Festival International du Film", a name that remained in use until 1974, after which it was renamed Palme d'Or again. en.s: The 1970 European Cup Winners' Cup Final was a football match between 1968-69 FA Cup winners, Manchester City of England and 1968-69 Polish Cup winners, Górnik Zabrze of Poland on 29 April 1970 at Praterstadion in Vienna, Austria. It was the final match of the 1969–70 European Cup Winners' Cup and the tenth European Cup Winners' Cup final. Both sides made their first appearance in a European final.

zh.s: 1970年欧洲优胜者杯决赛于1970年4月29日在奥地利维也纳普拉特球场举行，对阵双方是1968至1969赛季英格兰足总杯冠军曼彻斯特城和波兰杯冠军扎布热矿工。这是1969至1970赛季欧洲优胜者杯的决赛，也是该赛事的第十场决赛。两队此前都未参加过欧洲赛事决赛。

en.s: The 1970 Quebec general election was held on April 29, 1970, to elect members of the National Assembly of Quebec. The former Legislative Assembly had been renamed the "National Assembly" in 1968, with its members now known in English as Members of the National Assembly (MNAs). In the election, the Quebec Liberal Party, led by Robert Bourassa, defeated the incumbent Union Nationale, led by Premier Jean-Jacques Bertrand.

en.s: Operation Patio was a covert aerial interdiction effort conducted by the U.S. Seventh Air Force in Cambodia from 24 to 29 April 1970 during the Vietnam War. It served as a tactical adjunct to the heavier B-52 Stratofortress bombing missions being carried out in Operation Menu.

en.s: General elections were held in Fiji between 15 and 29 April 1972, the first since independence from the United Kingdom in 1970. They were characterised by the lack of rancour between racial groups, typical of the 1966 general election and the 1968 by-elections. The result was a landslide for the Alliance Party of the Prime Minister, Ratu Sir Kamisese Mara, which won 33 of the 52 seats, and surprised many observers by capturing almost 25 percent of the Indo-Fijian vote. The Indo-Fijian-dominated National Federation Party, led by Sidiq Koya, won the remaining 19 seats.

zh.s: 1972年4月15日至29日，斐济举行大选，这是斐济1970年脱离英国独立后首次大选。不同族群之间没有出现明显冲突，与1966年大选和1968年补选形成对比。总理拉图·卡米塞塞·马拉领导的联盟党大胜，赢得52席中的33席；该党获得近四分之一印度裔选民支持，让许多观察人士感到意外。以西迪克·科亚为首、由印度裔主导的民族联盟党赢得其余19席。

en.s: The 1973 WFA Cup Final was the third final of the WFA Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was played under the auspices of the Women's Football Association (WFA). Southampton and Westthorn United contested the match at The Eyrie, the former home of Bedford Town on 29 April 1973. Southampton won the match 2–0.

It was carried out on 29–30 April 1975, during the last days of the Vietnam War. More than 7,000 people were evacuated by helicopter from various points in Saigon.

en.s: The People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) is the national military force of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam and the armed wing of the ruling Communist Party of Vietnam (CPV). en.s: General elections were held in South Africa on 29 April 1981. The National Party, under the leadership of P. W. en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 29 April 1982. The Legislative Assembly voted on three candidates nominated by the armed forces. Álvaro Alfredo Magaña Borja, leader of the Democratic Action, was elected by 36 votes to 17, ahead of the Nationalist Republican Alliance (ARENA) and Party of National Conciliation candidates. Roberto D'Aubuisson accused Jaime Abdul Gutiérrez Avendaño of imposing on the Assembly "his personal decision to put Álvaro Alfredo Magaña Borja in the presidency" in spite of a "categorical no" from the ARENA deputies. Magaña was sworn into office on 2 May.

en.s: STS-51-B was the 17th flight of the NASA Space Shuttle program and the seventh flight of Space Shuttle Challenger. The launch of Challenger on April 29, 1985, was delayed by 2 minutes and 18 seconds, due to a launch processing failure. Challenger was initially rolled out to the pad to launch on the STS-51-E mission. The shuttle was rolled back when a timing issue emerged with the TDRS-B satellite.

en.s: The 1990 Football League Cup final took place at Wembley Stadium on 29 April 1990. It was the 30th League Cup final, and was contested between Nottingham Forest and Oldham Athletic. Nigel Jemson scored the only goal of the game, shooting low to the net after his initial shot had been saved. As of 2026, this is the last time that Nottingham Forest won the League Cup and a major trophy in general.

en.s: The 1991 Racha earthquake occurred in the province of Racha, Georgia, at 9:12 UTC on 29 April. Centered on the districts of Oni and Ambrolauri on the southern foothills of the Greater Caucasus mountains, it killed 270, left approximately 100,000 homeless and caused severe damage, including to several medieval monuments. It had a magnitude of 7.0 and was the most powerful earthquake recorded in the Caucasus.

en.s: General elections were held in the Gambia on 29 April 1992. The election date was announced on 14 February and the National Assembly was dissolved three days later. A total of 130 candidates ran for the 36 elected seats, though the ruling People's Progressive Party was the only one with a candidate in every seat. Although he had announced his retirement in December 1991, President Dawda Jawara changed his mind and ran for the position again. Both elections were won by the PPP, with Jawara remaining president, winning 58.5% of the vote. Voter turnout was around 55.8%.

zh.s: 1992年4月29日，冈比亚举行大选。选举日期于2月14日公布，国民议会三天后解散。共有130名候选人角逐36个民选席位，执政党人民进步党是唯一在所有选区都推出候选人的政党。总统达乌达·贾瓦拉原本于1991年12月宣布退休，后来改变主意再次参选。人民进步党赢得议会选举，贾瓦拉也以58.5%的得票率连任总统。投票率约为55.8%。

en.s: General elections were held in South Africa between 26 and 29 April 1994. The elections were the first in South Africa in which citizens of all races could vote, bringing an end to the herrenvolk democracy that had existed since 1948 and marking the country's first election under universal suffrage. The election was conducted under the direction of the Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), and marked the culmination of the four-year process that ended apartheid.

zh.s: 南非于1994年4月26日至29日举行大选。这是南非首次允许所有种族的公民投票，结束了自1948年以来的白人统治民主制度，也是该国首次实行普选的选举。选举由独立选举委员会负责，并标志着为期四年的进程走向完成，种族隔离制度也随之结束。

en.s: The wedding of Prince William and Catherine Middleton took place on Friday, 29 April 2011 at Westminster Abbey in London, England. William was second in the line of succession to the British throne at the time, later becoming heir apparent. The couple had been in a relationship since 2003.

en.s: Extreme Rules (2012) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by WWE. It took place on April 29, 2012 at the Allstate Arena in Rosemont, Illinois. It was the fourth event under the Extreme Rules chronology. Eight professional wrestling matches were scheduled on the event's card and one pre-show match was streamed on YouTube. It included Brock Lesnar's first WWE match since WrestleMania XX in 2004. The concept of Extreme Rules was that the event comprised various hardcore-based matches. In the main event, John Cena defeated Brock Lesnar in an Extreme Rules match.

zh.s: 2012年《极限规则》是WWE举办的一场按次付费赛事，于2012年4月29日在伊利诺伊州罗斯蒙特的全州体育馆举行，是该系列的第四场赛事。正式比赛共安排八场，另有一场预热赛通过YouTube直播。这是布洛克·莱斯纳自2004年《摔角狂热20》后首次参加WWE比赛。赛事主题是以各种硬核规则赛为主。主赛中，约翰·塞纳在极限规则赛中击败布洛克·莱斯纳。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Guinea-Bissau on 18 March 2012 following the death of President Malam Bacai Sanhá on 9 January. A run-off was set to be held on 29 April after being postponed by a week as announced by electoral commission chief Desejado Lima Dacosta. However, after a military coup, the leading candidates were arrested and the election was cancelled.

en.s: On April 29, 2013 at 10:38am CEST (8:38 UTC), an explosion occurred in a building in the centre of Prague, Czech Republic. The incident occurred in a townhouse belonging to the Air Navigation Services of the Czech Republic on Divadelní street in Old Town, Prague 1, close to the Academy of Sciences and National Theatre. The blast could be heard across the whole city centre, as far away as Prague Castle, 1.4 km (1 mi) away from the incident. 43 people were injured by the blast, one seriously. No one was killed.

zh.s: 2013年4月29日欧洲中部夏令时间上午10时38分（协调世界时8时38分），捷克布拉格市中心一栋建筑发生爆炸。事发建筑位于老城区第一区迪瓦德尔尼街，是捷克空中交通服务公司的办公楼，靠近科学院和国家剧院。爆炸声传遍市中心，远至1.4公里外的布拉格城堡也能听见。爆炸造成43人受伤，其中一人伤势严重，无人死亡。

en.s: National Airlines Flight 102 (N8102/NCR102) was a cargo flight operated by National Airlines between Camp Bastion (now Camp Shorabak) near the city of Lashkargah in Afghanistan and Al Maktoum International Airport in Dubai, with a refueling stop at Bagram Airfield, Afghanistan. On April 29, 2013, the Boeing 747-400 operating the flight crashed within the perimeter of the Bagram Airfield moments after taking off, killing all seven people on board.

zh.t: 美国国家航空公司102号班机空难
zh.s: 美国国家航空公司102号班机（N8102/NCR102）是一趟货运航班，往返阿富汗拉什卡尔加附近的巴斯蒂翁营（今沙拉巴克营）与迪拜的阿勒马克图姆国际机场，并在阿富汗巴格拉姆空军基地经停加油。2013年4月29日，执行该航班的波音747-400客机起飞后不久，在巴格拉姆空军基地范围内坠毁，机上7人全部遇难。

en.s: The Arena México 60th Anniversary Show was a major professional wrestling show produced by the Mexican lucha libre professional wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre ("World Wrestling Council"; CMLL) and took place on April 29, 2016, in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico. The annual event commemorates the 1956 opening of Arena México, nicknamed "The Cathedral of Lucha Libre", CMLL's main venue and the largest arena ever built specifically for professional wrestling.

zh.t: 墨西哥竞技场60周年纪念赛
zh.s: 墨西哥竞技场60周年纪念赛是由墨西哥职业摔角推广公司世界摔角委员会（CMLL）举办的一场重要赛事，于2016年4月29日在墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举行。这场年度赛事纪念墨西哥竞技场于1956年开幕。该场馆被称为“摔角大教堂”，是CMLL的主要场馆，也是专为职业摔角建造过的最大体育馆。
